question: As time progresses in the main story, ‘The Incident 14 Years Ago’ will have it’s name change to ‘The Incident 15 Years Ago’ or ‘The Incident 16 Years Ago’, won’t it. Isn’t that confusing? Please, make up an appropriate name for it.
answer: That’s true.... it’s bothersome, and I get confused, too. Hmm, let’s see. Well, the fight with the White Whale where Wilhelm’s wife died is “The Great Conquest”. The incident where Felt (maybe) was abducted is “The Royal Abduction Incident”. Was there anything else? If there was, let me know. I’ll think about it.
